statements.text: My espresso is not like an Italian espresso.
There is one Italian espresso specification to compare against.

provenance.note: Hidden reference carried by the intake wording.

statements.text: Shots taste sour on some occasions, bitter and harsh on others, and flat with no crema.
Which taste appears varies randomly from shot to shot.
Sourness and bitterness occur in different shots, never in the same sip.

provenance.note: What IS NOT: no mixed sour-and-bitter cup.

statements.text: The same coffee also tasted bad when brewed at a bar.

provenance.note: First answer; contradicted by stmt_espresso_007 and kept, never deleted.

statements.text: The same pre-ground bag, brewed by a barista at a bar, tasted fine.

provenance.note: Where IS NOT, after the contradiction was resolved with the person.

statements.text: The coffee is supermarket pre-ground and carries no roast date.

provenance.note: When: needs more data; age cannot be established.

statements.text: The home machine is a compact thermoblock pump machine used with a pressurized single-hole basket.
The machine has not been descaled for a long time, possibly never.
What are the shot time, the quantity in the cup and their spread over several shots?
The drinker consistently enjoys the cup, judged against a reference they declare.

ladder.outcome: The machine brews within its own specification.
assumptions: the coffee is fit for espresso
ladder.loss: Coffee, water, routine and the drinker's reference are out of view.

ladder.outcome: Extraction is repeatable from shot to shot.
ladder.scope: Coffee bed, water path, pressure and temperature during one shot.
assumptions: the reference cup is taken as given
ladder.loss: Purchasing, maintenance and the experienced cup are treated as fixed inputs.

ladder.outcome: The home routine, from buying coffee to descaling, delivers the reference cup.
ladder.scope: Purchase, storage, preparation, brewing, water and maintenance at home.
assumptions: the drinker can change the routine
ladder.loss: Single-shot physics becomes one lever among several; measures become slower to observe.

ladder.outcome: The drinker consistently enjoys the cup against a declared reference.
ladder.scope: The cup as experienced: taste, crema, temperature, context and expectation.
success_measures: drinker rating against the declared reference
ladder.loss: Measures become partly sensory and the causes are far from the measure.

frames.question: Which espresso reference is the drinker comparing against, and by how much does the cup deviate from it?
frames.outcome: A declared reference and a measured deviation from it.
success_measures: deviation per measure against the reference
open_questions: INEI or Comitato parameters, or the drinker's own bar?

frames.question: Is the coffee as bought fit for espresso?
frames.outcome: Coffee whose age and grind suit espresso.
assumptions: the bar result implicates the coffee
open_questions: Rejected after stmt_espresso_007: the same bag brewed fine at a bar.

frames.question: Why does extraction on the home machine vary from shot to shot?
frames.outcome: Repeatable extraction on the home machine.
assumptions: the coffee can brew a good shot, per stmt_espresso_007
open_questions: Shot time and quantity spread are not yet measured (stmt_espresso_011).

frames.question: Does the home routine, including water and maintenance, keep the machine inside its operating range?
frames.outcome: A routine that keeps the machine in range.
assumptions: maintenance is under the drinker's control
